comment: Hashes are FNV-1a 32-bit. MODULES ('kind':'module') hash the exact ModuleScript Source bytes. TEMPLATES ('kind':'template') hash a CANONICAL SERIALISATION of a GuiObject subtree (sorted children, whitelisted+sorted properties, attributes, tags; ViewportFrame 3D contents excluded) -- see docs/decisions/ADR-0005-instance-tree-hashing.md. tools/hash_shared.luau computes both inside Studio and marks template hashes with a trailing '*'. 'deployed' records the hash last verified in each Place; null = not yet deployed. Any mismatch between file hash and a deployed hash = DRIFT: stop and reconcile before working on shared systems.

MetaMath.comment: Added B3 2026-08-09 (AD-Gacha, Lobby). The algorithms the blueprint says to implement ONCE for every meta system: Slot(period, offsetSec) deterministic time buckets (rotations/resets agree across servers with no MessagingService and no stored state), RngForSlot(slot, salt), Pick(rng, {{v,w}}) weighted choice, PickDistinct. Cross-phase invariant 3 routes every reset/rotation through Slot(). PURE -- no services, no state, no config reads; the reset-hour knob is MetaConfig.ResetOffsetSec and is passed IN, which is what keeps this Place-neutral. NOTE the `salt` argument on RngForSlot: without it two banners sharing a RotationPeriod would draw the identical featured set forever. GAME DEPLOY PENDING -- deliberately NOT deployed there yet: nothing in the Game reads it until Phase D challenges need Slot(), so the Game reporting MISSING is the EXPECTED state, not drift. Deploy it (and flip deployed.Game) in the session that first needs it.

TraitRegistry.comment: AD-Traits canon. Lookup + the WEIGHTED ROLL over TraitDefinitions. API is Roll(rng) -> traitId; there is NO RollTrait -- SummonEngine assumed that name from B3 until 2026-08-09 and, because the call sat inside a pcall, trait-on-summon failed SILENTLY the whole time. RewardScalingConfig.comment: Difficulty->gold curve + the Insane item table (PlayGUI blueprint section 8). Added P5 2026-08-13 (owner AD-Game). SHARED because section 8 requires the Lobby's reward PREVIEW and the server's actual payout to read the SAME curve -- the preview must not invent numbers. It could NOT live in StageConfig.Rewards: the Lobby's StageRegistry is a hand-maintained MIRROR carrying structure only, with no reward table and no drift check, so gold numbers there would be two uncheckable copies. WorthinessConfig is the counter-example and does not apply (the Lobby reads worthiness as a STORED result; a pre-match preview has nothing stored to read). Owns the Game's ONE wire->t conversion, TFromWire: the wire scale is 100-1000 while the UI scale is 1-100 (ADR-0011), and confusing them pays maximum gold for a normal match. Clamps, never extrapolates. DEPLOYED TO BOTH PLACES since B20 2026-08-14 (AD-Integration): copied BYTE-IDENTICAL from the Game (6870 bytes, re-hashed in the Lobby to 1d789978), never re-authored. The Lobby's deployPath needed a new RS.Configs.Global FOLDER, which did not exist in that Place. The reward PREVIEW is still not wired -- StoryModeController's renderRewards() cannot express a min-max band and only re-runs on act selection, while P4 republishes DifficultyWire on every slider move, so wiring it honestly needs more than the one call AD-UI's canon allows: see docs/proposals/2026-08-14-reward-preview-wiring.md.
